scope: Read-only end-of-cycle audit of status, frozen baseline, experiment artifact, handoff module, tests and current diff. No acceptance, publication or source edits performed.

prototypes.name: compact_json
prototypes.observed: 1676 fewer normalized cl100k input tokens than baseline; payload equality across 18 replays. No observed repair-quality effect.

prototypes.name: literal_unicode
prototypes.observed: 76 fewer normalized tokens than compact JSON, attributable to one synthetic Unicode boundary case. Do not extrapolate this distribution to user workloads.

prototypes.name: structured_brief
prototypes.observed: Not wired to runtime; +1116 normalized tokens versus compact Unicode and no observed quality benefit, so not promoted.

findings.message: No actual first-attempt repair success evidence exists. Historical outcomes and provider costs remain null. Eighteen cases mix historical fixtures, uploaded failures, derived regressions and one synthetic boundary; they are not independent historical failed builds.
Normalized cl100k prompt counts exclude provider schemas/chat framing and do not measure provider billed tokens, response quality, latency, end-to-end completion or savings in money.
Final runtime diff adds ledger identity/character metrics only. Production serialization, accepted fields, repair budgets, frozen checks, provider ordering and runtime permissions remain unchanged.

During the prototype planning serialization changed too, beyond the CODE-only replay coverage. Resolved by rolling back all production serialization changes; a regression test asserts the legacy prompt bytes.
Prompt digest is an identifier, not anonymity or a proof of correctness. Keep it out of privacy/security claims; low-entropy content can in principle be guessed.

Unicode token effect is tokenizer/model/distribution dependent. Existing outer provider JSON encoding remains ASCII-escaped on the wire; benchmark savings refer to the model-visible inner prompt, not network bytes.
Reports do not prove live cloud/local adapter behavior or native Windows compatibility for this change. A scripted response test is an integration contract check, not independent app-repair evidence.

next_single_bounded_falsifiable_proposal.name: paired fixed-provider first-attempt repair pilot
next_single_bounded_falsifiable_proposal.scope: Before expanding runtime prompts or retrieval, preregister six independently executable failing fixtures from existing Notes/dashboard repairs, one pinned provider/model/settings, baseline and compact-Unicode handoff, one repair attempt each; at most 12 inference calls with a fixed token and spend ceiling and explicit cloud consent. Apply candidates only in disposable copies.
next_single_bounded_falsifiable_proposal.oracle: Require independently authored original-defect fail-before/pass-after evidence plus immutable regression tests, source identity and valid patch application; record transport failures separately without silent retries.
next_single_bounded_falsifiable_proposal.falsifiable_gate: Reject a repair-quality improvement claim unless candidate first-attempt independently verified repairs exceed paired baseline with no regression losses. Small pilot results remain descriptive and cannot establish general improvement.

rollback_criterion: Revert serialization intervention if any decoded field/source changes, applicable planning/generation/repair/browser regression fails, provider adapter rejects supported Unicode payloads, or source/frozen-evidence protections change. Do not promote structured brief without measured repair benefit.
production_promotion: No prompt/scaffold policy prototype promoted. Legacy inference serialization retained; new size/digest instrumentation is observational only.
review_concerns_resolved: Production planner and coder retain exact legacy JSON serialization; regression test asserts it.
All three prompt prototypes remain evaluation-only because actual repair-rate/cost equivalence is unmeasured.

provenance_errata.reason: Constructed diagnostic paired with historical Notes source. That source imports cgi and copies its server; the urlopen diagnostic is not proven to have occurred in this Notes fixture. Do not count this as a historical Notes failure.
